QuestInfo.0: #p2151003# thanked you, and has something to discuss with you. Go talk to #b#p2151003##k at #b#m310010000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2151000##k at #b#m310010000##k has something for you. Go see him.
QuestInfo.2: Looks like you're part of the Resistance now. It's a strange feeling...having comrades again.

0.0: Any suspicions we had about your loyalties are gone. You've saved Resistance Headquarters, and for that, you have earned our trust.\r\n#L0##bI do not care about your trust or suspicions, but I have a name, and you should use it. I am #h0#.#l\n#k
0.1: Ah, my apologies, #h0#. Now, have you considered joining forces with us, to battle the Black Mage?\r\n#L0##b(Allies, eh? I hadn't thought about that...)#l\n#k
0.2: According to #p2151010#, your training went quite well. But, with respect, #h0#, you're only one...person? Demon? Whatever. The Black Mage has powerful followers in the Black Wings, and together, I think we can take them down.\r\n#L0##b(I'll ignore that crack about my identity...for now. As for the Black Wings...)#l\n#k
0.3: If you truly want to fight the Black Mage alone, I won't stop you. But together, we can be far more powerful.\r\n#L0##b(I want my revenge on the Black Mage...but these Black Wings ARE going to get in my way. Perhaps the Resistance can be useful to me after all.)#l\n#k

yes.0: Excellent! Then, welcome to the Resistance! The Black Wings don't stand a chance.
yes.1: Oh, #b#p2151000##k told me that he prepared something for you. You should see what it is. #b#p2151000##k is in #b#m310010000##k.

no.0: That is quite unfortunate. By joining forces, we could do a lot more damage to our enemies...

1.0: Hey! I heard you've joined the Resistance. Good choice! I have some leftover items you can have. Interested?\r\n#L0##bAm I interested in second-hand junk? No.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, don't be such a snob. Try 'em out!
